description: A climber's personal logbook tick recording an ascent or attempt on a route

subject.description: The OpenStreetMap climbing route, pitch, or boulder being ticked. Absent for routes that are not on OpenStreetMap (yet)

outcome.description: Whether the route was sent or only attempted. Optional for minimal ticks.

sendStyle.description: Send style: redpoint by default, or strictly onsight, flash, or pinkpoint (with preplaced gear for trad climbs). Only valid when outcome is send.

attemptStyle.description: Attempt style: hangdog (working the route with hangs) by default, or bailed. Only valid when outcome is attempt.

hangs.description: Number of hangs, when the attempt style is hangdog

ascentInfo.description: Additional climbing style qualifiers (toprope, solo, second, aid). A clean send is implied when unspecified: these are only set to say the ascent was not clean, or had another exceptional style.

comment.description: Personal comment or notes on the ascent

name.description: Route name, set for ticks without a subject

grade.description: Route grade as written in the source logbook, for ticks without a subject

locationHint.description: Hierarchical location of the crag, shallowest first (e.g. ['France', 'Vercors', 'La Balme']), for ticks without a subject

climbedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when the climb occurred. Optional for minimal ticks.

createdAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when this tick record was created

ascentOutcome.description: Whether a climbing tick is a send or an attempt

sendStyle.description: Style of a sent climb (redpoint by default, or strictly onsight, flash, or pinkpoint)

attemptStyle.description: Style of an attempted climb (to top or bailed)

ascentInfo.description: Additional climbing style/ascent qualifier. Lead is implied when unspecified.
